app_fee.value: The Faculty of Graduate Studies application fee is CAD 115, paid before the application is processed.
app_fee.quote: To apply, complete the online application form and pay the $115 application fee. | Payment must be received before your application is processed.

fee_waiver.value: Payment must be received before your application is processed; no application-fee waivers are offered.
fee_waiver.quote: To apply, complete the online application form and pay the $115 application fee. Payment must be received before your application is processed.

gre_general.value: The Faculty of Graduate Studies sets no campus-wide GRE requirement; programs set their own requirements.
gre_general.quote: Meeting the Faculty of Graduate Studies’ minimum standards does not guarantee admission to all of Dalhousie's graduate programs

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 92 for tests taken before 21 January 2026; for later tests, 4.5 overall on the new 1-6 scale. Some programs ask for more.
toefl_min.quote: Test of English as a Foreign Language | For tests taken before January 21, 2026 | Minimum acceptable score: 92 | For tests taken on or after January 21, 2026, only the 1-6 score scale* is considered: Overall score of at least 4.5.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall. Some programs ask for more.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS (Academic, in-person and online) | Minimum acceptable score: 7

english_waiver.value: You can request a waiver during the application if your degree is from a recognized university taught in English, in a country where English is an official language (India qualifies on that wording); it is not automatic.
english_waiver.quote: It is possible to have this requirement waived if you completed your degree at a recognized university where the language of instruction is English and in a country where English is one of the official languages. | You will be able to request this waiver during the application process.

notes: All graduate programs apply through the Faculty of Graduate Studies. General deadline for non-Canadians is April 1 for September entry; several departments set earlier dates. FGS minimum for a PhD is a thesis-based master's with a 3.0 GPA over the last 60 credit hours.
